title: Certified Deep Learning Course IISc: Advanced Certification
description: ## Lead the AI Revolution with Deep Learning. ## Advanced Certification Programme in Deep Learning Foundations and Applications. # The Deep Learning course. The **Advanced Certification Course in Deep Learning** is offered by TalentSprint in collaboration with Center of Continuing Education at IISc is a **10-month** weekend program that enables both aspiring and practicing AI/ML professionals to build expertise in Deep Learning. The program is delivered through a unique **5-step** learning process that includes LIVE online interactive sessions by faculty members of IISc and TalentSprint, capstone projects, mentorship, case studies, and 2 days of campus visit to IISc. This fast-track learning process ensures that students gain hands-on experience in applying deep learning techniques to real-world scenarios. As a deep learning certification course, this program focuses on developing a practical understanding of optimizing machine learning algorithms for hardware to create edge computing systems. With its **comprehensive curriculum, experienced faculty members, and unique learning process**, this program offers a valuable opportunity for individuals who want to specialize in deep learning and advance their careers in the field of AI/ML.

I am from the third batch, and the previous post's OP is from the program's fifth batch. You can opt for more AI courses if you are interested in AI.
